verdict.rationale: Morph publishes an official MCP server with a dedicated guide (docs.morphllm.com/guides/mcp), confirmed by probe. It exposes Morph's fast file editing plus `codebase_search` (Warp-Grep) and `github_codebase_search` tools, and the quickstart tells users to install the Morph MCP so Claude Code can use it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server in use, and setup details (config, auth, supported clients beyond Claude Code) are only lightly evidenced.
